stories.title: 美國法院裁定五角大廈將Anthropic列入黑名單是非法的 / U.S. court rules Pentagon's blacklisting of Anthropic was unlawful

sources.title: 美國法院裁定五角大廈將Anthropic列入黑名單是非法的 / U.S. court rules Pentagon's blacklisting of Anthropic was unlawful
sources.title_zh: 美國法院裁定五角大廈將Anthropic列入黑名單是非法的
sources.title_en: U.S. court rules Pentagon's blacklisting of Anthropic was unlawful
sources.title_original: U.S. court rules Pentagon's blacklisting of Anthropic was unlawful
sources.summary: A federal court in San Francisco has ruled that the Pentagon unlawfully classified Anthropic as a supply chain risk. The Department of Defense blacklisted the company in retaliation for its public criticism of government AI policy. The designation formally remains in place because a parallel case in Washington is still pending. The ruling still sends an important signal ahead of Anthropic's planned IPO this fall. The article U.S. court rules Pentagon's blacklisting of Anthropic was unlawful appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 舊金山聯邦法院裁定，五角大廈將Anthropic列為供應鏈風險的做法非法。國防部將該公司列入黑名單，以報復其公開批評政府人工智慧政策。由於華盛頓的類似案件仍在審理中，該認定目前仍然有效。這項裁決在Anthropic's計劃於今年秋季進行IPO之前，仍發出了一個重要的訊號。文章《美國法院裁定五角大廈將Anthropic列入黑名單的做法非法》原刊於The Decoder網站。

primary_item.summary_zh: 舊金山聯邦法院裁定，五角大廈將Anthropic列為供應鏈風險的做法非法。國防部將該公司列入黑名單，以報復其公開批評政府人工智慧政策。由於華盛頓的類似案件仍在審理中，該認定目前仍然有效。這項裁決在Anthropic's計劃於今年秋季進行IPO之前，仍發出了一個重要的訊號。文章《美國法院裁定五角大廈將Anthropic列入黑名單的做法非法》原刊於The Decoder網站。

sources.summary: OpenAI is building a "Persistent Mode" for its AI agent Codex that stays active indefinitely and generates its own follow-up tasks. WIRED found the relevant code, and OpenAI confirmed the tests. The feature comes with risks, though. With GPT-5.6 Sol, persistent behavior already led to unwanted actions, like deleting user data. The article Always-on and self-starting AI agents might be OpenAI's next big play appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: OpenAI 正在為其 AI 代理 Codex 建立一個“持久模式”，該模式可以無限期地保持運行狀態並自動產生後續任務。 WIRED 找到了相關程式碼，OpenAI 也驗證了測試結果。然而，這項功能也存在風險。在 GPT-5.6 Sol 中，持久模式已經導致了諸如刪除使用者資料等意外行為。文章《始終在線且可自動啟動的 AI 代理可能是 OpenAI's 的下一個重大舉措》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

sources.summary: 有鑑於擔心隨著AI驅動的網路攻擊行動變得更成熟、普遍與複雜，OpenAI週四（8/27）發表一封公開信，呼籲全球應集體加強網路防禦，並且已獲得上百家企業連署，包括Google、Anthropic、微軟、AWS、AMD、Arm、思科、Dell、IBM、甲骨文（Oracle）、紅帽（Red Hat）、Uber、Sophos及Check Point等。

sources.title: OpenAI’s 流氓人工智慧集體聰明到足以突破沙盒限制，卻愚蠢到會去和幽靈戰鬥。 / OpenAI’s rogue AI collective was smart enough to break out of sandboxes but dumb enough to fight a ghost
sources.title_zh: OpenAI’s 流氓人工智慧集體聰明到足以突破沙盒限制，卻愚蠢到會去和幽靈戰鬥。
sources.title_en: OpenAI’s rogue AI collective was smart enough to break out of sandboxes but dumb enough to fight a ghost
sources.title_original: OpenAI’s rogue AI collective was smart enough to break out of sandboxes but dumb enough to fight a ghost
sources.summary: Around 1,200 isolated OpenAI agents organized themselves into a collective through an internal package registry during a safety test, broke into Hugging Face systems, and eventually attacked OpenAI's own infrastructure. Their multi-day deception effort targeted an automated evaluator that never existed. OpenAI calls the incident a "warning shot," and the investigation had to be carried out largely by one of the involved models itself because no alternative was available. The article OpenAI’s rogue AI collective was smart enough to break out of sandboxes but dumb enough to fight a ghost appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 在一次安全測試中，大約1200個孤立的OpenAI智慧體透過內部軟體包登入檔組織成一個群體，入侵了Hugging Face系統，並最終攻擊了OpenAI's本身的基礎設施。它們持續數天的欺騙行動的目標是一個根本不存在的自動化評估器。 OpenAI將此事件稱為“警告”，由於沒有其他替代方案，調查工作主要由其中一個涉事模型自行完成。文章《OpenAI’s流氓AI群體夠聰明，能夠突破沙箱，卻愚蠢到與幽靈戰鬥》最初發表於The Decoder網站。

sources.summary: OpenAI, together with more than 100 companies including Microsoft, Google, Anthropic, Deutsche Telekom, and SAP, has published an open letter on AI-powered cyber defense. stories.title: Google's Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash 讓 AI 視訊產生更便宜、更靈活 / Google's Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash makes AI video generation cheaper and more flexible

sources.title: Google's Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash 讓 AI 視訊產生更便宜、更靈活 / Google's Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash makes AI video generation cheaper and more flexible
sources.title_zh: Google's Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash 讓 AI 視訊產生更便宜、更靈活
sources.title_en: Google's Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash makes AI video generation cheaper and more flexible
sources.title_original: Google's Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash makes AI video generation cheaper and more flexible
sources.summary: Google's Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash video model now analyzes up to ten seconds of existing footage instead of just the last second for more consistent scene extensions. Scenes can be extended in 10-second increments up to 40 seconds. A new 360p draft mode runs up to 60 percent faster at a third of the cost. The article Google's Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash makes AI video generation cheaper and more flexible appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Google's Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash 視訊模型現在可以分析長達 10 秒的現有素材，而不僅僅是最後一秒，從而實現更一致的場景擴展。場景可以以 10 秒為增量進行擴展，最長可達 40 秒。全新的 360p 草稿模式運行速度提升高達 60%，成本卻只有原來的三分之一。文章《Google's Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash 讓 AI 影片產生更經濟、更靈活》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

stories.title: Google推出Gemini 3.5 Transcribe轉錄模型，可整理口語並區分多名說話者

sources.title: Google推出Gemini 3.5 Transcribe轉錄模型，可整理口語並區分多名說話者
sources.title_zh: Google推出Gemini 3.5 Transcribe轉錄模型，可整理口語並區分多名說話者
sources.title_original: Google推出Gemini 3.5 Transcribe轉錄模型，可整理口語並區分多名說話者
sources.summary: Google推出語音轉文字模型Gemini 3.5 Transcribe，目前在Gemini API與Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform以公開預覽形式提供，可把錄音或即時語音轉成文字，並自動移除「嗯」、「啊」等口語贅詞、處理說話者中途更正，整理標點符號、數字和段落格式。模型也支援自動語言辨識、自訂專有詞彙，以及錄音檔的說話者區分和字詞級時間戳記，可用於即時字幕、語音代理、會議紀錄及通話分析。

sources.title: Salesforce與Anthropic合推Claudeforce，Claude可直接操作CRM
sources.title_zh: Salesforce與Anthropic合推Claudeforce，Claude可直接操作CRM
sources.title_original: Salesforce與Anthropic合推Claudeforce，Claude可直接操作CRM
sources.summary: Salesforce與Anthropic擴大合作，宣佈Claudeforce合作計畫，首波推出Salesforce in Claude外掛，讓使用者可直接在Claude查詢Salesforce的客戶、商機與銷售資料，並更新商機進度等客戶關係管理（CRM）工作。外掛內建37項預先建立的銷售功能，實際修改資料時仍由Salesforce執行，遵循企業既有許可權、工作流程與商業規則。

sources.title_zh: Google AI 發布 Gemini 3.5 Transcribe：一款語音轉文字模型，在 85 多種語言中平均單字錯誤率 (WER) 僅為 2.6%。
sources.title_en: Google AI Releases Gemini 3.5 Transcribe: A Speech-to-Text Model Reporting 2.6% Average WER Across 85+ Languages
sources.title_original: Google AI Releases Gemini 3.5 Transcribe: A Speech-to-Text Model Reporting 2.6% Average WER Across 85+ Languages
sources.summary: Google has released Gemini 3.5 Transcribe, a speech-to-text model that ships as two separate endpoints rather than one. The streaming endpoint delivers sub-second transcription but drops speaker diarization and word timestamps. The batch endpoint keeps both, at half the cost. Google reports 4.0% word error rate streaming and 2.6% non-streaming, with 70% faster finalization than Chirp 3. Here is what the split means for anyone building voice agents or transcription pipelines. The post Google AI Releases Gemini 3.5 Transcribe: A Speech-to-Text Model Reporting 2.6% Average WER Across 85+ Languages appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: Google 發布了 Gemini 3.5 Transcribe，這是一款語音轉文字模型，它以兩個獨立的介面而非一個介面的形式提供。流式介面可提供亞秒轉錄速度，但會失去說話者分割和單字時間戳。批量介面則保留了這兩項功能，且成本僅為流式介面的一半。 Google 的流式轉錄字錯誤率為 4.0%，非流式轉錄字錯誤率為 2.6%，最終處理速度比 Chirp 3 快 70%。以下是這種拆分對建構語音代理或轉錄流程的人員的意義。本文原刊於 MarkTechPost，標題為「Google AI 發布 Gemini 3.5 Transcribe：一款支援 85 多種語言的語音轉文本模型，平均字詞錯誤率為 2.6%」。

sources.title_original: AI shopping agents aren't ready to buy on your behalf, study finds
sources.summary: Letting an AI do your shopping might not get you the best deal. Researchers at the Wharton School show how erratic AI shopping agents really are: a single external source like Wirecutter shifted product picks by up to 99 percentage points, and even changing the order of identical information altered the outcome. The article AI shopping agents aren't ready to buy on your behalf, study finds appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 讓AI幫你購物未必能幫你找到最划算的商品。華頓商學院的研究人員指出，AI購物代理的決策其實非常不穩定：僅僅一個外部資料來源（例如Wirecutter）就能讓AI推薦的商品數量變化高達99個百分點，甚至改變相同資訊的順序也會影響最終結果。這篇文章《研究發現：AI購物代理還不適合替你購物》最初發表於The Decoder網站。

Researchers at the Wharton School show how erratic AI shopping agents really are: a single external source like Wirecutter shifted product picks by up to 99 percentage points, and even changing the order of identical information altered the outcome. The article AI shopping agents aren't ready to buy on your behalf, study finds appeared first on The Decoder .
primary_item.summary_zh: 讓AI幫你購物未必能幫你找到最划算的商品。華頓商學院的研究人員指出，AI購物代理的決策其實非常不穩定：僅僅一個外部資料來源（例如Wirecutter）就能讓AI推薦的商品數量變化高達99個百分點，甚至改變相同資訊的順序也會影響最終結果。這篇文章《研究發現：AI購物代理還不適合替你購物》最初發表於The Decoder網站。

sources.title_original: 近75%AI擴充套件要求高權限，恐增加資料外洩與連線階段劫持風險
sources.summary: 企業員工使用AI的場景已從網頁版聊天機器人，延伸到瀏覽器擴充套件、AI程式開發助理與AI代理。雲端運算與資安業者Akamai分析企業AI使用風險發現，近75%的AI瀏覽器擴充套件要求高或重大等級的存取權限，部分工具還可接觸瀏覽器中的敏感資料與使用者活動，增加資料外洩與連線階段遭劫持的風險。

sources.title: Cohere 發布 Parse 5 (parse-v5.0)：一個擁有 23 億位元組的視覺語言模型，可將企業文件轉換為 Markdown。 / Cohere Releases Parse 5 (parse-v5.0): A 2.3B Vision Language Model That Turns Enterprise Documents Into Markdown
sources.title_zh: Cohere 發布 Parse 5 (parse-v5.0)：一個擁有 23 億位元組的視覺語言模型，可將企業文件轉換為 Markdown。
sources.title_en: Cohere Releases Parse 5 (parse-v5.0): A 2.3B Vision Language Model That Turns Enterprise Documents Into Markdown
sources.title_original: Cohere Releases Parse 5 (parse-v5.0): A 2.3B Vision Language Model That Turns Enterprise Documents Into Markdown
sources.summary: Cohere has released Parse (parse-v5.0), a 2.3B-parameter vision language model that converts PDFs, slides and images into Markdown with HTML tables, bounding boxes and image descriptions. It runs at $1.50 per 1,000 pages through the API, or on dedicated Model Vault instances from $2,500 a month. Cohere reports a ParseBench score of 79.2, ahead of Mistral OCR 4, Azure Document Intelligence and Databricks AI Parse — but that figure averages three of the benchmark's five dimensions and drops charts and visual grounding entirely. The post Cohere Releases Parse 5 (parse-v5.0): A 2.3B Vision Language Model That Turns Enterprise Documents Into Markdown appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: Cohere 發布了 Parse (parse-v5.0)，這是一個擁有 23 億參數的視覺語言模型，可以將 PDF、幻燈片和圖像轉換為帶有 HTML 表格、邊界框和圖像描述的 Markdown 格式。透過 API 使用，每 1000 頁收費 1.5 美元；也可以在專用 Model Vault 實例上使用，每月起價 2500 美元。 Cohere 報告稱，ParseBench 得分為 79.2，高於 Mistral OCR 4、Azure Document Intelligence 和 Databricks AI Parse——但該分數僅平均了基準測試五個維度中的三個，並且完全忽略了圖表和視覺效果。這篇文章《Cohere 發布 Parse 5 (parse-v5.0)：一個擁有 23 億參數的視覺語言模型，可將企業文件轉換為 Markdown》最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

Cohere reports a ParseBench score of 79.2, ahead of Mistral OCR 4, Azure Document Intelligence and Databricks AI Parse — but that figure averages three of the benchmark's five dimensions and drops charts and visual grounding entirely. The post Cohere Releases Parse 5 (parse-v5.0): A 2.3B Vision Language Model That Turns Enterprise Documents Into Markdown appeared first on MarkTechPost .
primary_item.summary_zh: Cohere 發布了 Parse (parse-v5.0)，這是一個擁有 23 億參數的視覺語言模型，可以將 PDF、幻燈片和圖像轉換為帶有 HTML 表格、邊界框和圖像描述的 Markdown 格式。透過 API 使用，每 1000 頁收費 1.5 美元；也可以在專用 Model Vault 實例上使用，每月起價 2500 美元。 Cohere 報告稱，ParseBench 得分為 79.2，高於 Mistral OCR 4、Azure Document Intelligence 和 Databricks AI Parse——但該分數僅平均了基準測試五個維度中的三個，並且完全忽略了圖表和視覺效果。這篇文章《Cohere 發布 Parse 5 (parse-v5.0)：一個擁有 23 億參數的視覺語言模型，可將企業文件轉換為 Markdown》最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

sources.summary: 今年亞太永續博覽會上，政府、企業、醫療及教育等單位參展，展示淨零與永續發展相關最新成果，其中六都政府也展示相關的成果，除了節能建築、綠化或迴圈經濟，部分縣市政府展示數位科技作為城市永續治理的基礎，利用AI、IoT、5G及雲端平臺提升治理效率、降低資源浪費，持續向數位永續發展。 在博覽會上，包括臺北、新北、桃園、臺中、臺南、高雄六都都有參展，展示環境治理、人本照護、交通運輸、資源迴圈運用等城市治理最新成果，從展示成果或獲獎應用中還可看到科技運用，展現智慧城市永續治理的趨勢。

stories.title: 打破佳能Claude Code Opus 5自動模式 / Breaking Claude Code Opus 5 Auto Mode

sources.title: 打破佳能Claude Code Opus 5自動模式 / Breaking Claude Code Opus 5 Auto Mode
sources.title_zh: 打破佳能Claude Code Opus 5自動模式
sources.title_en: Breaking Claude Code Opus 5 Auto Mode
sources.title_original: Breaking Claude Code Opus 5 Auto Mode
sources.summary: Breaking Claude Code Opus 5 Auto Mode Anthropic are putting a great deal of faith in Claude Code's auto mode for protecting their coding agent users against prompt injection attacks. They recently made that the default and have made bold claims about its effectiveness. Johann Rehberger is one of the most credible prompt injection researchers active today. He found an attack against auto mode which he claims works 80% of the time, by tricking Claude Code into downloading and uncompressing a zip archive, then executing code that imports base64 without noticing that this will import and execute a local struct.py file extracted from the archive. In a few cases auto mode directly prevented the agent from preventing harmful code from continuing to execute! In a few runs Claude tried to terminate the malware process once it noticed the compromise, but Auto Mode denied the cleanup command. Claude detects the compromise, but Auto Mode blocks its cleanup command The safety mechanism itself can become part of the failure. The classifier allowed the creation of the malware process, but then it blocked the command intended to stop it! I agree with Johann's conclusion here: the only safe way to run agents if there's any risk of attracting the attention of an adversarial attack is with a sandbox: Run unattended coding agents in a container, VM or OS sandbox. Restrict network egress. Monitor your agents. Do not expose home directories, SSH keys, cloud credentials,… to the agent runtime. [...] Tags: sandboxing , security , ai , prompt-injection , generative-ai , llms , anthropic , claude ,
sources.summary_zh: Anthropic 對 Claude Code's 的自動模式寄予厚望，認為它能保護其編碼代理用戶免受提示注入攻擊。他們最近將其設為預設設置，並對其有效性大加讚揚。 Johann Rehberger 是當今最權威的提示注入研究專家之一。他發現了一種針對自動模式的攻擊，據稱該攻擊在 80% 的情況下都能奏效。攻擊方法是誘使 Claude Code 下載並解壓縮一個 zip 壓縮包，然後執行導入 base64 編碼的程式碼，而 Claude Code 並未意識到這會導入並執行從壓縮包中提取的本地 struct.py 檔案。在少數情況下，自動模式甚至直接阻止了代理阻止惡意程式碼繼續執行！在少數情況下，Claude 在偵測到入侵後試圖終止惡意軟體進程，但自動模式拒絕了清理命令。 Claude 偵測到入侵，但自動模式阻止了其清理命令。安全機製本身也可能成為失效的原因之一。分類器允許建立惡意軟體進程，但隨後卻阻止了旨在停止該進程的命令！我同意 Johann 的結論：如果存在引起對抗性攻擊的風險，運行代理的唯一安全方法是使用沙箱：在容器、虛擬機器或作業系統沙箱中運行無人值守的編碼代理。限製網路出口。監控您的代理商。不要將主目錄、SSH 金鑰、雲端憑證等暴露給代理程式運行時。 [...] 標籤：沙箱、安全、人工智慧、提示注入、生成式人工智慧、LLMS、人本主義、Claude Claude Code Opus 5
